title: Three Shifts (counterfactual: renamed entities, shifted clock +2h, expanded)
source: Perturbed twin of story_05_three_shifts -- same gold graph, renamed characters, time offset +2h

events.text: Dr. Ferreira's ER shift begins at 9:00pm and runs until 9:00am.
Nurse Solis's ICU shift also begins at 9:00pm, but wraps up early at 3:00am.
Danh's patrol shift starts at 11:00pm, two hours after the others, and also ends at 9:00am.
At 1:00am, Ferreira's team handles a mass-casualty influx lasting until 4:00am.
Her shift includes a code blue at 9:30pm that resolves by 10:15pm.
He actually begins an equipment check at 7:00pm sharp, though his official patrol doesn't start until 9:00pm.
A second ER team, led by Dr. Ochoa, starts its own on-call block at 9:00pm sharp too, running only until 2:00am.
The overnight nurse's follow-up block starts at 2:00am and, like everyone else, wraps at 7:00am.
Danh radios a final all-clear at 9:00am, the exact moment three shifts end together.
Ferreira's triage sub-block runs 9:00pm-11:00pm, the first two hours of her shift.
A trauma consult occupies 7:00am-9:00am, closing out the shift alongside Ferreira.
Overnight staffing review spans 10:00pm-8:00am, contained entirely within Ferreira's shift.
The second ER team's extended debrief, led by Dr. Ochoa, stretches from 9:00pm to 3:00am, wrapping an hour after the team's on-call block ends.
A quiet lull in the ER, 12:00am-1:00am, sits right before the mass-casualty influx begins at 1:00am.
The mass-casualty aftermath cleanup runs 4:00am-6:00am, right after the influx ends, extending Ferreira's team's workload.
Solis's medication rounds run 9:00pm-10:00pm, the opening hour of her ICU shift.
A ventilator check spans 2:00am-3:00am, the final hour before Solis's shift wraps.
Chart audits occupy 9:30pm-2:30am, nested inside Solis's shift from start to finish.
The code blue response team's extended monitoring continues 11:30pm-1:00am -- the same start as the code blue itself but lasting longer.
A lull before the follow-up block, 3:00am-4:00am, sits directly between Solis's shift ending and Wren's block beginning.
Wren's follow-up documentation, 4:00am-9:00am, exactly matches the full span of her clinical follow-up block.
Danh's perimeter sweep runs 11:00pm-1:00am, the opening two hours of patrol.
A final badge-check sweep spans 7:00am-9:00am, closing out patrol alongside the all-clear.
Radio log review is nested 12:00am-8:00am within the patrol shift.
The equipment check's paperwork tail extends 9:00pm-12:00am -- the same start as the check itself but ending later.
His mid-shift break, 10:00pm-10:15pm, is swallowed entirely within the perimeter sweep.
A supervisor radio check spans 8:00am-9:00am, the closing hour of the badge-check sweep.
Pharmacist Nakata's overnight dispensing window opens at 9:00pm and runs until 9:00am, mirroring Ferreira's ER shift exactly.
A controlled-substance count runs 9:00pm-10:00pm, the opening hour of Nakata's dispensing window.
End-of-shift reconciliation spans 8:00am-9:00am, the final hour before the dispensing window closes.
Automated restock logging is nested 10:00pm-8:00am within the full dispensing window.
A STAT medication request tied to the mass-casualty influx is filled 1:15am-1:45am, nested inside that same 1:00am-4:00am surge.
The night pharmacist's break, 3:00am-3:30am, falls within the restock logging block.
A narcotics audit spans 11:00pm-1:00am, the exact same window as Danh's opening perimeter sweep, start to end.
A refrigerated-medication temperature log straddles the start of the shift, running 8:30pm-9:30pm.
The pharmacy's full-shift equipment sterilization block spans 9:00pm-9:00am as well, containing every sub-task including the 11:00pm-1:00am narcotics audit.
Dispatcher Kade's overnight desk coverage spans 8:00pm-8:00am.
Ambulance Run 12 departs at 8:00pm and returns at 8:45pm, the opening call of the shift.
Run 13 spans 7:00am-8:00am, the last call before coverage ends.
Dispatch log review is nested 9:00pm-7:00am within the full coverage window.
Run 14 departs at 8:45pm, exactly as Run 12 returns, and lasts until 9:30pm.
Run 15 overlaps the tail of Run 14, running 9:15pm-10:00pm.
A dispatch equipment restock block spans 10:00pm-6:00am.
Run 16 spans 11:00pm-11:30pm, nested inside the equipment restock block.
Run 17, the final call, spans 7:00am-8:00am, exactly matching Run 13 in start and end.
Clerk Reyna's overnight filing window spans 9:00pm-9:00am.
The intake-forms batch is filed 9:00pm-11:00pm, the opening two hours of the filing window.
The final compliance sign-off spans 8:00am-9:00am, the closing hour of the filing window.
Routine chart-stamping is nested 10:00pm-7:00am within the full filing window.
A backlog-clearing block, 11:00pm-1:00am, begins the moment the intake-forms batch ends.
Reyna's shift-note review overlaps the backlog-clearing block, spanning 12:30am-1:30am.
A supervisor audit block, 10:30pm-6:30am, contains the backlog-clearing block and everything logged during it.
A misfiled-report correction, 1:00am-1:15am, is swallowed entirely within the supervisor audit block.
The compliance sign-off and Reyna's final timestamp both land at 9:00am, the instant the filing window closes.
